name: Married at First Sight
description: Working with leading relationship experts, eight Australian singles are carefully match-made into four married couples, who each meet each other - for the very first time - at their wedding. We'll follow them as they marry, honeymoon, meet the in-laws and set up home, all the while getting to know one another more and more deeply, to see if the matchmakers have got it right and they will have a future together.

videos.title: Grand Reunion (1)
videos.overview: The most memorable brides and grooms from past seasons come together for a huge dinner party that will see old flames reunited and old feuds reignited.

videos.title: Grand Reunion (2)
videos.overview: Favourites from past seasons are back on the couch to relive their time in the experiment and reveal some life-changing experiences since they left. Includes Troy, Martha, Dean, Tracey, Cyrell and Ines.

videos.title: Countdown to Decision Day
videos.overview: Three former "Married at First Sight" couples discuss their own experiences and make predictions for what will happen on "Decision Day" with the couples from Atlanta.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The first two couples paired up by the relationship experts meet at the altar for their wedding ceremonies. Will romantic sparks fly when they lock eyes for the first time, or could doubts creep in?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Another two couples experience a very unusual first date - their own wedding! One bride's feeling daunted but the final pair experience instant attraction. And all four couples go on their honeymoons.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The heat is turned up on the pressure-cooker relationships as the newlyweds move in together and begin to experience everyday married life. How will they fare in their first few days as Mr and Mrs?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The experiment has reached its halfway stage and an intimate dinner party in Sydney provides the first opportunity for the four couples to meet and compare how their relationships are working out.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: With one week to go until the newlyweds have to make their big decision, some of the couples manage to visit the in-laws, improve communication and strengthen relationships but one pair are struggling.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The social experiment is over and the relationship experts gather to hear the couples make one of the biggest decisions of their lives. Will the participants opt to stay married or ask for a divorce?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The expert team of matchmakers pair up the first two couples and the cameras follow the preparations for their big day. How will they react on meeting for the first time at the wedding ceremony?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Two pairs of newlyweds wake up in their beds for the first time as husband and wife. The last two couples are matched up by the experts and all eyes are on them as the wedding ceremonies begin.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The four pairs of newlyweds spend a week getting to know each other on their honeymoons. An expectation of romance and intimacy hangs in the air, but not all of the couples are comfortable together.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: After knowing each other for only a week, the couples move in together. There's nowhere to hide and emotions run high as they grapple with sharing their personal space on an intimate level.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A dinner party occurs, attended by all four pairs of newlyweds. The couples compare the strength of their own relationship with those around them, but no one is prepared for the fireworks that ensue.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Decision day is just over a week away and the couples are feeling the pressure as they weigh up the strengths and weaknesses of their union. They also face the test of a weekend with the in-laws.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: With just 72 hours to go, the couples temporarily separate and avoid all contact with each other while they seek the counsel of friends and family. The stakes are high and hearts are on the line.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The experiment comes to an end as the newlyweds decide: will they stay in their relationships or cut their losses? Two months later, cameras revisit participants to see which pairs are still together.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: We meet our first four singles and follow them and their families as they prepare for the biggest day of their lives – a day that should see them say "I do" to a complete stranger.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A day earlier, our first two couples were complete strangers. Now, the morning after the wedding, they wake up together to their new reality as husband and wife. Meanwhile, six more singles come together to comprise our final three couples.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Four weddings down, one to go, and it looks like our expert matchmakers are on a roll as couples three and four get hot and heavy at the wedding reception. But is it love or lust at play?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Following on from the intensity of the weddings, the honeymoon is the first time our couples will have spent any real time alone together, and they will all be asking themselves: is this relationship really going to work?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Our couples are set to return from their honeymoons and enter the third phase of the experiment: moving in together. But pressure is mounting on some couples as they grapple with trust issues compromise.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: This season's dinner party will push everyone to the brink. Until now, our couples have existed in a vacuum without contact with one another. Tonight this will change as they size each other up and question the strength of their own relationship.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Our three final couples may have survived the dinner party, but no one has emerged unscathed. Cracks are beginning to appear everywhere, even among the most unlikely of couples. How will this affect the couples as they meet their in-laws?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: It's crunch time for our couples as they meet with our expert matchmakers and reveal whether or not they will continue their relationship beyond the experiment. It's a decision that will change their lives forever. Who will stay and who will go?

videos.overview: Tonight, our newlyweds enter Intimacy Week. After receiving much needed guidance from the experts, some couples chose to embrace the challenge, while others remain hesitant.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Revelations Week asks our couples to be vulnerable as a new task begins. In front of peers raw truths will be exposed, but it's one grooms honesty that leaves the room speechless.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: At the second Dinner Party, while some couples are feeling the love, others are are on a warpath, resulting in a dinner party so confronting - it has to be seen to be believed.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Love is in the air at the Commitment Ceremony as some celebrate incredible breakthroughs. The Experts unpack the question on everyone's lips, and call out a brides bad behaviour.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The experiment enters its next exciting chapter. Over two big nights, love will be in the air when three brand new couples enter the experiment, in the ultimate leap of faith.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Witness one of the most incredible matches the experiment has ever seen as our final couple are married. And, the original couples celebrate their first milestone.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Our three new couples make their Dinner Party debut. However, still harbouring resentment, one bride explodes at everyone in her sight, sending the dinner party into meltdown.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Romantic connections continue to grow at the Commitment Ceremony, with some couples planning their futures. The experts hold others to much needed account, delivering hard truths.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Family & Friends Week begins, and our couples gain much-needed perspective from their partners' loved ones. The newlyweds enter the apartments for a crash course in married life.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Advice from their nearest and dearest allows some couples to take massive steps forward, with others taking two steps backward. And, a bombshell is dropped about one bride.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: As we approach the halfway point of the experiment, our couples attend the fourth Dinner Party. One marriage implodes in a shocking tirade that will leave everyone speechless.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Love is in the air at the Commitment Ceremony as couples make significant progress. Unfiltered opinions cause tension amongst the group, and sorry seems to be the hardest word.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: We've past the halfway mark and it's time for the annual Couples Retreat. Our happy couples are loving the change in scenery, until one bad joke sends the retreat into meltdown.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: As the retreat continues, actions from the Girls and Boys nights leave one couple isolated from the group. Then, at the final drinks night, lingering tensions reach boiling point.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: It's the day after an explosive couples retreat, and following the intense week away - our newlyweds are now attending the fifth dinner party of the experiment.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: With only three commitment ceremonies remaining, the stakes have never been so high. But despite the intensity of the week, some couples connections have become even stronger.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: The next critical phase of the experiment begins, Feedback Week. The couples receive unfiltered feedback from their peers. And, the truth comes out as screenshots are shared.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: After Feedback Week, the couples come together to reflect and unpack at the Dinner Party. But feedback is not all they'll be unpacking, as one of the strongest couples implodes.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: It's the second last Commitment Ceremony, and some are already locking in plans for life outside the experiment. But there is one blindside that will leave the room speechless.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: It's the second last Commitment Ceremony, and some are already locking in plans for life outside the experiment. But there is one blindside that will leave the room speechless.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: As we enter the final stages, Homestays Week has arrived! Over two big nights, our couples will get a glimpse of what their relationships could look like beyond the experiment.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Homestay Week continues as our couples get a taste of life outside the experiment. But as they see what their partners natural environment looks like, tough questions will arise.

videos.title: Epsiode 32
videos.overview: It's the second last Dinner Party of this years experiment. While some couples are thriving, tensions rise when others air their concerns, and a shock debate divides the table.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: It's the final commitment ceremony of the experiment, and after two months of marriage, tonight marks the last time our couples will come face to face with the experts.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: The unforgettable Final Test is back, and this season the experts have upped the anti like never before - removing choice. All participants will meet with their alternate matches.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: The final and most radical phase of the experiment sees a huge twist, as our Brides and Grooms now watch back on the footage of the Final Test, rocking some to their core.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: The Final Dinner Party. The dramatic last group get together before Final Vows.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Final Vows. The couples separate to consider whether or not they want to take their relationship into the real world.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: The Reunion Part 1. All the participants are back for one final dinner party and a lot of unfinished business.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: The Reunion Finale. The participants are all back for one final couch session with the experts and first look at videos of their MAFS journey.
